messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice@retailnova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo? exploring embeddings for search + recommendations

Hi Grace,

I signed up on the self-serve flow this morning (really like the quick onboarding!) and wanted to see if we could get a short demo to understand deployment options and cost/perf tradeoffs. A quick summary of what we're exploring: 

- Use case: product search + related-item recommendations (ranking + semantic fallback)
- Current infra: in-house microservices, PostgreSQL + Redis; looking to offload vector search and inference
- Traffic: ~1.5M MAU, typical day: 8–12M queries/month; peak traffic ~110–130 qps during morning spikes
- Query characteristics: average query ~18–25 tokens; embeddings 768 dim; many short prefix queries
- Timeline: pilot in ~6–8 weeks, production in Q1 next year if pilot goes well

Would appreciate a short 30m walkthrough focused on: model choices for embeddings/search, latency expectations at peak, and what a pilot looks like. I attached a quick traffic export (traffic_estimates.csv) from our analytics so you have context. 

Thanks — happy to align to a time that works for your team.

Best,
Alice Gomez
Director of ML, RetailNova

(415) 555-0192

Hi Alice — welcome and thanks for the context (nice to meet you). I looped Ben (SDR) on this thread to help coordinate a short technical walkthrough — we typically do a 30–45m session with an SE for pilot scoping. Before we lock a slot, a few quick qualification items so we tailor the demo: 

1) Latency SLAs: are you targeting p95 < 250ms for search? or more aggressive?
2) Embedding size & vector index: you noted 768 — is that a hard requirement or flexible?
3) Concurrency pattern: is the 110–130 qps sustained for 10–30 min bursts, or is it shorter spikes?
4) Data sensitivity: any PII or regulated data in the payloads that would affect private deployment options?
5) Pilot scope: do you want a PoC that runs in our hosted environment or Private (VPC/on-prem) for compliance?

If you can answer those briefly, we’ll propose 3 slots and pick the right SE. Quick availability from our side next week: 
- Tue 9/14 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 9/15 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 9/16 09:30–10:15 PT

Or drop a time that works and we’ll accommodate. I’ll include Ben to book — Ben, can you hold Wed 14:00 PT tentatively?

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Alice Gomez <alice@retailnova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Sep 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? exploring embeddings for search + recommendations

Hi Grace — great, answers inline below. I also re-attached the traffic export for the SE.

1) Latency SLO: aiming for p95 < 200ms for search (mobile-heavy traffic), p50 ideally under 75ms.
2) Embedding: 768 is what our current model outputs; we’re open to quantized/ops-reduced variants if quality stays consistent.
3) Concurrency: spikes are usually 10–25 minutes during promo windows — sustained peak for ~15 minutes, then back to baseline (~20 qps).
4) Data sensitivity: no regulated PII, but we do send user ids and product ids; customer content is proprietary — would prefer data isolation for production.
5) Pilot scope: hosted for the pilot is fine (we want faster time-to-value), but production will likely go Private/VPC.

Preferred slot: Wed 9/15 14:00 PT works for me. Attached: traffic_estimates.csv (contains per-hour qps samples, 30-day slice).

Thanks — Alice
